name: Billora – PDF Invoice Builder For WooCommerce
author: Akram ul haq

sections.description:
Billora – PDF Invoice Builder For WooCommerce lets you design beautiful PDF invoices using a visual drag-and-drop builder.

✨ Key Features

  • Drag-and-drop invoice builder (no coding needed)
  • Auto-attach invoice to WooCommerce emails
  • Add logo, branding, and custom fields
  • Multiple invoice templates
  • Supports refunds and credit notes
  • Dynamic shortcodes for order data
  • Multilingual ready (WPML + Polylang)
  • Developer hooks & filters for customization

🚀 Why Use This Plugin

Manually creating invoices is messy. This plugin automates it beautifully.
With live preview and design freedom, you can generate branded invoices instantly after an order is placed.

🧰 Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Invoice Settings in your admin panel.
  3. Choose a pre-built template or create your own (creating allowed in paid version only).
  4. Customize using the builder (add logo, store name, address and footer).
  5. Save and test by viewing any WooCommerce order.

📦 Integration

Fully compatible with:
* WooCommerce (3.5+)
* WooCommerce Subscriptions
* Multi-Currency & Multilingual sites

🛠️ Developer Friendly

Use actions and filters to inject custom data or modify invoice structure programmatically.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/billora-pdf-invoice-builder-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → PDF Invoice Builder to configure your invoice settings.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce 3.5+ and tested up to the latest version.

Can I customize the invoice design?

Yes, you can customize the invoice layout, add your logo, change colors, and modify the content using the built-in template system.

Can I attach invoices to WooCommerce emails?

Yes, you can automatically attach PDF invoices to order confirmation, completed order, and other WooCommerce emails.
